summary: Sports app with a ShortSport reels section featuring TikTok-style vertical scrolling and a floating auto-scroll toggle button in the bottom-right corner.

existing_features.title: Update ShortSportPage to support TikTok-style vertical manual scrolling, where users can swipe or scroll up/down to navigate between video reels one at a time with snap-scrolling behavior.

Add a floating auto-scroll toggle button in the bottom-right corner of ShortSportPage. When activated, the page automatically advances to the next reel at a set interval. Clicking the button again stops auto-scrolling. The button should visually indicate its active/inactive state.

new_feature_requests.summary: ShortSport section: vertical (TikTok-style) manual scrolling and floating auto-scroll toggle button in bottom-right corner
